elevation_profile_v2.description: Rollout of the new elevation profile: the redesigned graph, grade colouring and a climb summary. Tomás owns it. It stays at 25% of web users until the Safari crash rate is below 0.1% and the tile cache hit rate holds above 90%, then goes to everyone the week after 2.3 ships. We watch the share rate.
